about.title: Dr. Hutto's family has served Baytown since 1927
text: Dr. Hutto's family has served Baytown since his grandparents moved here in 1927, and his dad served as mayor for 12 years.
Dr. Hutto gives back through the Baytown Rotary Club and the Wounded Warriors Project, among other community groups.
In the office, the goal is to preserve as much of your healthy, natural smile as possible, and we file your insurance claims and paperwork for you.
